notes.subject: כארי
notes.rationale: MT pointing reads 'like a lion' (verbless clause), while KJV 'they pierced' reads כארו (from כור); DSS and LXX vary on this line.

notes.subject: i stap
notes.rationale: MT as 'like a lion' lacks a verb; Tok Pisin needs ⟨i stap⟩ to complete the clause.

notes.subject: סבבוני/הקיפוני
notes.rationale: Two near-synonymous verbs of surrounding in parallel cola; the repetition intensifies the encirclement.

translation: Long wanem, ol dok i raunim mi; olgeta lain bilong ol man i wokim nogut i raunim mi; olsem laion ⟨i stap⟩ long ol han bilong mi na ol lek bilong mi.

tokens.gloss: bilong ol man i wokim nogut
